original_target.title: Global classical continuation in the chemotaxis-consumption system

verification: Literature and theorem-scope review; no independent whole-proof or Lean verification.
scope_comparison: Original fully parabolic attractive u_t=Delta u-div(u grad v),v_t=Delta v-u v with Neumann boundary, all n>=3 and arbitrary allowed initial data, classical through every finite time. Lankeit–Winkler Theorem1.2 gives a global weak solution that is C2,1 only after some waiting time, leaving early classical continuation unproved. Located repulsive, nonlinear sensitivity/diffusivity, elliptic-signal or small-data results change original assumptions. Bounded current searches found no full match; not a certification of openness.
